subject: Credit note request for duplicate tax entry VEN036-0038
body:
Dear Royal Tech Ltd team,

We have identified that entry VEN036-0038 dated 11 Sep 2025 repeats VEN036-0022 dated 9 Sep 2025. The taxable value (Rs 43,334) and tax (Rs 5,200) are the same, resulting in tax being counted twice.

Please cancel the second entry so the tax is not counted twice, or issue a credit note for Rs 5,200.

Thank you.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
